## Tests

List the checks run and any limitations.

- [ ] Relevant local tests, lint and type checks pass.
- [ ] User-visible changes are described in CHANGELOG.md.
- [ ] Documentation links and examples refer to files that ship.
- [ ] My first contribution adds my name and GitHub username to CONTRIBUTORS.md.
- [ ] Fixtures are synthetic, and runtime behavior does not depend on a specific organization or repository.
